harness_surface.guardrails: CLAUDE.md (What this agent does not do) + .claude/settings.json deny
harness_surface.skills: skills/<id>@v<n>/ (SKILL.md, skill.json, scripts/, cases.json), run through src/run_skill.py

note: A build copies this tree, fills CLAUDE.md's placeholders, adds tools/<name>/ with adapter.py, tool.json and errors/, fills CAPABILITIES.json and envelope/, writes validation/ and replay/ tasks, copies the skills the specification names into skills/ unchanged and writes .claude/agents/<name>.md for the subagents it names. The diff from this tree is recorded next to the bundle. v2 adds src/run_skill.py and the Subagents section to v1 (meta_agent/tasks/010); v1 stays under templates/.
